030package dev.visdb.seesaw.formatting;
031
032import java.util.List;
033
034import dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources.DateTime;
035import dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources.RSC;
036
037/**
038 * Base class for date time fields; provides specialized component validation.
039 */
040@SuppressWarnings("serial")
041abstract public class DateTimeField extends Field {
042  /**
043   * Create.
044   * @param factory formatter factory
045   */
046  public DateTimeField(AbstractFormatterFactory factory) {
047    super(factory);
048  }
049
050  /**
051   * Sets the value of the field to an initial state consistent with
052   * the AllowNull property. If not AllowNull then use the current system date.
053   */
054  @Override
055  public void cleanField() {
056    if (getAllowNull()) {
057      setValue(null);
058    } else {
059      setValue(new java.util.Date());
060    }
061  }
062
063  /**
064   * Specialized Date/Time/Timestamp component validation.
065   * @param strings text to check: list[0] is masked, list[1] is plain
066   * @param comp
067   * @return false if the component does not have valid data.
068   */
069  public static boolean stringValidator(List<String> strings, RSC comp) {
070    if (!(comp instanceof DateTimeField dtfield))
071      return false;
072    if (DateTime.isHandledDateTimeComp(dtfield)) {
073      if (!dtfield.containsUserText()) {
074        if (DateTime.dateTimeColumnValidate("", dtfield))
075          return true;
076      }
077      for (String string : strings) {
078        if (DateTime.dateTimeColumnValidate(string, dtfield))
079          return true;
080      }
081    }
082    return false;
083  }
084}
